en: A monochrome vintage postcard showing a waterfront scene crowded with people along a quay in front of a large domed church-like building. Small boats are in the water in the foreground, one with people aboard, suggesting a ceremony or celebration taking place on the harbor. The text at the bottom reads in French "Argostoli - Fêtes de l'Épiphanie", indicating Epiphany festivities, with additional printing credits in the lower left and a website watermark across the image.
